title: Brewery Hop-On Hop-Off Trolley Tour of Nashville
includes: Unlimited safe, reliable transportation in our vintage trolley on the day of your ticket
Trolleys are lively with music over the speakers, and brewery insights from your trolley conductor
1-Day Pass for the Nashville Brewery Hop-On Hop-Off Trolley
Trolley loop travels outside the typical tourist areas into unique neighborhoods for a local feel
Visit one or several Nashville breweries without the hassle of driving

blurb:
Travel in a vintage trolley on a convenient 1-hour loop for a Nashville beer tour unlike any other. Hop on/off at your brewery picks!

Music City’s only hop-on hop-off trolley brewery tour includes unlimited rides the day of your ticket to explore the Nashville beer scene. With 7 different brewery stops on our 1-hour loop you are sure to find something for everyone. We visit Honeytree Meadery, Stoke Haus Brewing & BBQ, Tailgate East, Xul Beer Co., East Nashville Beer Works, Bearded Iris Brewing and Monday Night Preservation Society.

We make it easy to visit your choice of local unique neighborhood craft breweries providing safe, responsible, and fun transportation on your schedule. Hop-on and start your day at any of the 7 stops on our loop.

PLEASE NOTE: We only depart once from downtown each day (Omni Hotel Nashville/5th Ave side) and return several times in the evening. Our downtown departure is at 11:50am (daily). 
You can also meet us at ANY brewery on our tour and start there!
